name: worker_report
description: Report completion, a blocker, a request to continue, or the original assignment's cancellation or transfer. If the host reports native_cleanup_waiting, end the control turn so the Worker can verify its closure and submit the original confirmation.

name: worker_ask
description: Ask the manager a question about this formal assignment.

name: worker_ask_trainer
description: Publish a public clarification to the trainer when there is no native question panel for it. A reply resumes this same bound chat as a separate input. For formal assignments use worker_ask to ask the manager. Do not send secrets, permissions requests, or a duplicate of a native question.

request_id.description: Optional stable request ID to reuse for the same question within this turn.

name: worker_send_peer
description: Send a private message to a named Worker or reply to their original message. A pending response contains the message ID for later status checks. This does not create or complete a formal assignment.

name: worker_peer_status
description: Check Router intake, the recipient Worker inbox and the native host receipt for a private message you sent or received.

name: worker_submit_material
description: Submit separate candidate material for this earlier assignment while the task is still in the blocked pool. Receipt only records the material. It does not complete the task or change its holder.

name: worker_stage_artifacts
description: Stage files already owned by this Worker adapter for a formal report or a candidate material submission. Returns Router artifact IDs. Staging does not submit the report, share the files with the manager, or change the assignment.

name: worker_list_peers
description: List other registered Worker IDs available to contact. The directory reports whether each Worker connection is online and does not show their assignments.

name: worker_peer_inbox
description: Read this Worker's pending peer messages or the latest twenty reply-correlation records. Reading does not dispatch or acknowledge a message.
